summary: Homebrew package-manager checks, installation, updates, and diagnostics.

commons.summary: Homebrew common helpers for CLI availability, version output, and prefix diagnostics.

check.summary: Checks Homebrew availability and optional diagnostics.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print Homebrew prefix and brew doctor output when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

options.--dry-run: Print the official Homebrew install command without executing it, even if Homebrew is already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Runs the official Homebrew install script.
supported_hosts.linux: Runs the official Homebrew install script.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The user declines the install prompt.

update.summary: Updates Homebrew metadata and installed formulae/casks with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print Homebrew update commands without executing them, even if Homebrew is not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Runs brew update and brew upgrade.
supported_hosts.linux: Runs brew update and brew upgrade.

expected_failure_when: The user declines the update prompt.

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install or update Homebrew.
install mutates the host by running the official Homebrew install script and prompts unless --yes is provided.
update mutates installed Homebrew metadata and packages and prompts unless --yes is provided.
install and update support --dry-run where command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because Homebrew is already installed or currently missing.
No run command is currently defined because Homebrew does not expose a durable local app process for this skill.
